profileText: A Delegate from Maryland; born near Benedict, Charles County, Md., ca. 1731; appointed justice of the peace of Charles County, Md., April 1, 1777; tax commissioner of Charles County and also member of the State general assembly in 1777; Delegate to the Second Continental Congress, 1778-1780; died in Philadelphia, Pa., March 25, 1780; interment in the yard surrounding Christ Church.
